periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward tilt toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal cranial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal elongation.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible tapering and elongation extending toward the inferior-lateral region of the face.
